  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp upward spikes in price, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment turns negative (e.g., -0.25 or below) and historical price trends show downward momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10% to align with historical volatility.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is negative and price has recently been above 70.00, to account for potential correction.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; lag corrections by 1-2 days to prevent premature reversals.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50+), allow slight upward bias but cap at +10% above recent 30-day average to avoid overestimation.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast over 3 consecutive days, reduce forecast by 5-10% to reflect underestimation bias."
  ]
}
